description: Wave 4c: server-authoritative inventory. World (inventory gates place/break, snap=delta) + 2 bots with predicted movement walking close together (radius 2): break gives the block's item, place consumes the selected slot's item (the bot selects a placeable slot first), every 20 ticks a bot drops one item that either bot picks up by walking over it. End: bots go quiet, the world dumps inventories + dropped items + item ledger; every bot's mirror (slots, selected, hash) equals the world's, the world's item balance is 0 (created = in inventories + on the ground + placed + expired), drops/cross pickups/places happened; block consistency and per-tick replica hashes; then a protocol client sends invalid requests (bad slot, empty slot, count over, unknown op, place without the item, flood of 40) — each refused with its reason, the world lives.
